title: frontend/package.json engines (>=22.12) is looser than the dev toolchain requires (jsdom: ^22.22.2 || ^24.15.0 || >=26)
evidence: Verified 2026-10-14: npm ci on Node v24.14.0 / npm 11.9.0 prints EBADENGINE for jsdom@30.1.2, @asamuzakjp/css-color@7.1.5, @asamuzakjp/dom-selector@9.2.4 and w3c-xmlserializer@6.0.0, each requiring node '^22.22.2 || ^24.15.0 || >=26.0.0'; frontend/package.json declares "engines": { "node": ">=22.12" }. All checks still pass on 24.14.0 (lint, typecheck, 187 tests, build). CI and the Dockerfile pin Node 24.21.0, which satisfies the range.
impact: Low: a contributor on Node 22.12-22.22.1 or 24.0-24.14 gets warnings and possibly test-tooling failures that the declared engines range says should not happen. Runtime and build output are unaffected.
precautions: Changing engines is a frontend change for a frontend branch; the READMEs already state the real range. Do not add engine-strict without checking the CI and Docker Node versions.
verification: Set engines.node to '^22.22.2 || ^24.15.0 || >=26' (or the range the toolchain then requires) and run npm ci on the minimum version without EBADENGINE warnings.
